operation.description:
Lists the GitHub Actions caches for a repository.

OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
operation.summary: List GitHub Actions caches for a repository

#/components/parameters/actions-cache-gi.description: The full Git reference for narrowing down the cache. The `ref` for a branch should be formatted as `refs/heads/<branch name>`. To reference a pull request use `refs/pull/<number>/merge`.
#/components/parameters/actions-cache-gi.name: ref

#/components/parameters/actions-cache-ke.description: An explicit key or prefix for identifying the cache
#/components/parameters/actions-cache-ke.name: key

#/components/parameters/actions-cache-li.description: The property to sort the results by. `created_at` means when the cache was created. `last_accessed_at` means when the cache was last accessed. `size_in_bytes` is the size of the cache in bytes.
#/components/parameters/actions-cache-li.name: sort

#/components/parameters/direction.description: The direction to sort the results by.
#/components/parameters/direction.name: direction

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/page.description: The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."
#/components/parameters/page.name: page

#/components/parameters/per-page.description: The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."
#/components/parameters/per-page.name: per_page

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo
